note: A record-level timestamp with a non-Z offset (spec 4.3). A refusal here would contradict 6.2, whose refusal list is exactly four causes and whose rule for an unusable VALUE is drop-and-diagnose. Refusing would throw away every pip of a track over a badly spelled date, which is wildly disproportionate. The geometry and the pip times, which are integers and unaffected, all survive.

diagnostics.message_advisory: must be UTC with a Z suffix
